steps.body: Splitting a whole into **fourths** means cutting it into 4 equal parts. Each part is called a **fourth**. All 4 pieces must be the same size.

widget.prompt: If you split a whole into fourths, how many equal parts do you get?

commonErrors.feedback: That's halves. Fourths means splitting into 4 equal parts.
Splitting into fourths means more than 1 piece — it's 4 equal parts.

predict.prompt: Fourths versus halves — will each fourth be BIGGER or SMALLER than a half?
predict.reveal: Four sharers split the same bar that two sharers split — more parts means each part shrinks. A fourth is half of a half.

explanationVariants: One of 4 equal parts is called a fourth.
Splitting into 4 equal pieces gives you fourths.

widget.prompt: Split the bar into equal parts so each part is a fourth.

commonFractions.feedback: A half comes from splitting into 2 equal parts, not 4.
The whole is the entire shape before splitting. Each of 4 equal parts is a fourth.

widget.successFeedback: Yes — 4 equal parts are called fourths.
widget.highFeedback: Each of your parts is bigger than a fourth — split the bar into more pieces: exactly 4 equal parts.
widget.lowFeedback: Each of your parts is smaller than a fourth — that's too many pieces. A fourth needs exactly 4 equal parts.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents fourths.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for fourths must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines fourths.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

steps.body: **Quarter** is another name for a fourth — they mean exactly the same thing. "A quarter of the pizza" and "a fourth of the pizza" are the same size piece.

widget.prompt: "A quarter" and "a fourth" — are these the same size part?

options.label: Yes, same size
options.feedback: Yes — "quarter" and "fourth" are two names for the same equal part.

options.label: No, a quarter is bigger
options.feedback: A quarter isn't bigger — it's the exact same part, just called by another name.

options.label: No, a quarter is smaller
options.feedback: A quarter isn't smaller — 'quarter' and 'fourth' both name one of 4 equal parts.

steps.body: You can split into fourths by cutting in half, then cutting each half in half again. Two cuts, four equal pieces.

widget.prompt: If you split a whole into quarters, how many equal parts do you get?

commonErrors.feedback: That's halves. Quarters means 4 equal parts, same as fourths.
3 equal parts would be thirds, not quarters. Quarters is 4.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Quarters means 4 equal parts, just like fourths.

explanationVariants: One of 4 equal parts can be called a quarter.
"Quarter" and "fourth" name the same equal part.

widget.prompt: If a circle is split into 4 equal parts, what do you call each part?

options.label: a quarter
options.feedback: Yes — each of 4 equal parts can be called a quarter (or a fourth).

options.label: a half
options.feedback: A half comes from 2 equal parts, not 4.

options.label: a third
options.feedback: A third comes from 3 equal parts. 4 equal parts are fourths or quarters.

explanationVariants: Fourths must all be the same size — unequal pieces don't count.
4 pieces of different sizes aren't fourths.

widget.prompt: A rectangle is cut into 4 pieces of different sizes. Are these fourths?

options.label: No, they aren't equal
options.feedback: Yes — fourths must be 4 EQUAL parts, and these aren't equal.

options.label: Yes, there are 4 pieces
options.feedback: Having 4 pieces isn't enough — they must be equal in size to be fourths.

options.label: Yes, close enough
options.feedback: Fourths must be exactly equal, not just close in size.

explanationVariants: 4 equal parts are fourths — also called quarters.
Splitting into fourths always makes 4 equal parts.

widget.prompt: If you split a whole into fourths, how many equal parts do you get?

commonErrors.feedback: 2 would be halves. Fourths means 4 equal parts.
That's more than fourths. Fourths is 4 equal parts.

hints: "Fourth" means one of four equal parts.
So splitting into fourths makes 4 parts.

steps.body: Fourths (or quarters) are 4 equal parts of a whole.
takeaways: Fourths means splitting into 4 equal parts.
"Quarter" and "fourth" name the same size part.
All 4 pieces must match in size.
steps.teaser: next: how halves and fourths relate to each other.

concept.body: Splitting a whole into fourths means cutting it into 4 EQUAL parts, each called a fourth. "Quarter" is another name for the same thing.

widget.prompt: If you split a whole into fourths, how many equal parts do you get?

commonErrors.feedback: 2 is halves, not fourths. Fourths is 4.
